name: no-swallowed-trading-path-fallback
prevents: Trading-path failures must not silently degrade into null, false, undefined, or warn-only behavior.
worked_example: A broker, strategy, or state update catches an execution-path error, logs a warning, and returns a plausible fallback that lets trading continue.
prune_condition: Delete only if a structured error taxonomy and AST scanner replace this regex rule.
